article_title: Unis are offering degrees in content creation for £30,000. But are they worth it?

tasks.prompt: What question does the article investigate about university content-creation degrees?
options: Whether all social-media platforms should close
Whether a degree costing about £30,000 provides enough value for aspiring creators
Whether universities should stop teaching business subjects
Whether creators should work only for traditional television
tasks.correct_answer: Whether a degree costing about £30,000 provides enough value for aspiring creators
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת אם תואר יקר ביצירת תוכן מעניק יתרונות שמצדיקים עלות של כ־30 אלף ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: Which benefits of studying the degree are described in the article?
options: A guaranteed million followers
Access to equipment, industry contacts and structured professional learning
Automatic employment by every social-media platform
Freedom from producing any practical work
tasks.correct_answer: Access to equipment, industry contacts and structured professional learning
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בין היתרונות המתוארים: ציוד מקצועי, קשרים בתעשייה ומסגרת לימודים מסודרת לפיתוח מיומנויות.

tasks.prompt: What does “monetise” mean in the article?
options: Delete old content
Copy another creator's style
Turn content into a source of income
Study without using the internet
tasks.correct_answer: Turn content into a source of income
tasks.explanation_hebrew: monetise פירושו להפוך תוכן למקור הכנסה, למשל באמצעות עסקאות עם מותגים או מקורות רווח אחרים.

tasks.prompt: What does “saturated” suggest about the online market for creator advice?
options: It is available only inside universities.
It has no information at all.
It is controlled by one creator.
It is already very full of competing content and free advice.
tasks.correct_answer: It is already very full of competing content and free advice.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: saturated פירושו רווי או גדוש; בהקשר הזה כבר יש ברשת שפע עצום של עצות ותוכן מתחרה.

tasks.prompt: What concern is raised by the length and cost of the qualification?
options: Students are not allowed to create content during the course.
People can learn many creator skills online without committing to a long, expensive degree.
The degree contains no practical equipment.
Universities refuse to teach business strategy.
tasks.correct_answer: People can learn many creator skills online without committing to a long, expensive degree.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הספק נובע מכך שחלק גדול מן הידע זמין בחינם ברשת, ולכן יש השואלים אם כדאי להתחייב לתואר ארוך ויקר.

tasks.prompt: Why are transferable skills important in evaluating the degree?
options: They guarantee viral success on every platform.
They remove the need for creativity.
They can be used in several careers even if a graduate does not become a full-time influencer.
They prevent social-media platforms from changing.
tasks.correct_answer: They can be used in several careers even if a graduate does not become a full-time influencer.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כישורים הניתנים להעברה—כמו הפקה, אסטרטגיה וניתוח נתונים—עשויים לסייע גם במקצועות אחרים ולא רק בקריירה כמשפיען.

tasks.prompt: Give three things students may gain from a university content-creation course.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה יתרונות קונקרטיים שהכתבה מייחסת למסלול ולנסח כיצד כל אחד יכול לסייע לקריירה.
expected_points: Access to professional equipment or studio facilities.
Industry contacts and networking opportunities.
A recognised qualification and a clearer career pathway.
Practical training in creativity, production and content strategy.
Business skills for monetising work and using data to adapt strategies.
Transferable professional skills that apply beyond influencing.

tasks.prompt: Why might a successful creator still say that a degree is not necessary for everyone?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את החלופות הזמינות, את אי־הוודאות בהכנסות ואת ההבדל בין מסגרת לימודית לבין ניסיון מעשי.
expected_points: Free online advice makes self-directed learning possible.
Creators can build a niche by publishing and testing content directly.
Success and income are not guaranteed by a qualification.
A long course requires a major financial and time commitment.
Some learners may value university equipment, contacts and structure more than others.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the strongest arguments for and against paying for a content-creation degree.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להציג באופן מאוזן לפחות שני יתרונות ושני חסרונות, ולחזור לשאלת התמורה ביחס לעלות.
expected_points: Supporters point to equipment, expert teaching, contacts and a structured pathway.
The degree can teach creative, professional and business skills, including monetisation and strategy.
The skills may transfer to jobs beyond being an influencer.
Critics note the roughly £30,000 cost and the long commitment.
Much advice is available free online, while creator income remains uncertain.
The value depends on the student's goals, learning style and use of the opportunities.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, advise an aspiring creator how to decide whether this degree is worth the cost.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג מסגרת החלטה ברורה, להשתמש בלפחות ארבע ראיות מן הכתבה ולתת המלצה מותנית ולא תשובה כללית בלבד.
expected_points: Compare tuition and living costs with affordable or free alternatives.
Assess whether access to equipment, contacts and structured feedback is personally valuable.
Check the course's practical modules, graduate outcomes and industry links.
Consider whether transferable skills support a broader career plan.
Test interest by creating content and trying to monetise it before committing.
Recognise that a degree can provide a pathway but cannot guarantee income or audience growth.
